summary.en: Help us run and optimise modern greenhouse operations for professional growers in the São Paulo region.

description.en: Oboya Horticulture supplies climate control, irrigation and growing solutions to professional growers worldwide. As a Greenhouse Technician you will support installations and day-to-day operation of customer greenhouses, working closely with our agronomy and sales teams.

responsibilities.en:
• Install, calibrate and maintain climate, fertigation and irrigation systems.
  • Monitor crop environment data and recommend adjustments.
  • Train grower teams on equipment and best practices.
  • Report site visits and spare-part needs.

requirements.en:
• Technical degree in agronomy, horticulture, mechatronics or similar.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with greenhouse or irrigation systems.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites.
  • Working English is a plus.

niceToHave.en:
• Experience with climate computers or automation controllers.
  • Valid driver's license.

benefits.en:
• Health and dental insurance.
  • Meal allowance.
  • Ongoing technical training.
